entries.reason: The land a place stands on when nothing names another, so a small town made from its card stands where one made from a sentence that names no land does. Measured under land rules 6 on the development machine: six of six identities made a town on it, 4.7 s median to compose one in the request.

entries.reason: A market town stands where roads meet on a valley floor, its high street running between the two ridges. Measured under land rules 6 on the development machine: six of six identities made a town on every land recipe, and the valley composed fastest in the request, 4.2 s median against 6.8 s on gentle hills and 16.3 s on the coast.
